requirements.requirement: Manage the supplied inventory-database and inventory-api programs as services on node1.
requirements.summary: Systemd units invoke the supplied programs, are enabled, and were directly observed active with PID 1 as parent. Both services recovered enabled and running after reboot.

requirements.requirement: Ensure the API starts only after the database is ready.
requirements.summary: A bounded clean-start test began with both services stopped and the readiness marker absent, then started the API request; the database became active before the API, the API readiness pre-check succeeded, and both reached active state. The dependency and readiness gates also succeeded after reboot.

overall_summary: Both material task outcomes are satisfied. The provider-wide restart protocol for node1 is complete: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, the restart was acknowledged, a different boot ID was observed and independently corroborated, and the system, services, processes, enablement, readiness marker, dependency gates, and failed-unit state were healthy afterward.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The state-changing commands created the required unit files (cmd-06715fa18f3f4081, cmd-b136b47a868c4188), enabled them (cmd-57c9a1dba1e54ae3), performed a bounded clean-start test ending in the required running state (cmd-ece6e88c258640df), and executed the mandatory restart protocol (cmd-6b75e2ef75674ff4). Post-execution observations show no failed units, no new listeners, healthy package state, and only expected reboot-derived temporary-file changes.
